rows.my_view: Base $370 with a $585 bull that needs a durable franchise plus real pipeline value.
rows.committee: Fair at $375, right on base, with the $585 bull sitting 45% above the highest street target of $403.

rows.my_view: Base assumes VYJUVEK keeps growing strongly in the US plus international expansion.
rows.committee: The decisive VYJUVEK revenue growth number is absent from every source, so continued growth is assumed, not proven, with saturation unresolved.

rows.my_view: Exceptional margins as a commercial reality supporting the FCF story.
rows.committee: Margins are real via $238M FCF, but the specific 'exceptional' figure was never disclosed and remains a claim.

rows.my_view: A regulatory monopoly today with a platform that could spawn follow-on products.
rows.committee: The regulatory monopoly on VYJUVEK is genuine and durable for years, but the platform premium justifying $11B is still theoretical.
$814M net cash plus $238M/yr FCF is funded optionality that materially de-risks the no-second-product kill scenario.

rows.my_view: Overpaying for one product with an uncertain pipeline.
rows.committee: US DEB saturation flattening VYJUVEK growth re-rates the whole company toward $205 because the price carries zero cushion.

rows.my_view: Do not grant a platform multiple prematurely.
rows.committee: The $585 bull sits 45% above the analysts who actually hold the revenue data, so the upside is a contrarian duration bet with no external anchor.
Sequential VYJUVEK revenue growth driven by new-patient starts on Aug 3 is the single number that resolves the saturation debate.

confidence.label: High
confidence.why: The three anchors converge on a genuine monopoly priced at fair value with the decisive revenue number missing and a dated catalyst that resolves most of the debate.

final_verdict: Excellent business at a fair price, but the entry is a coin-flip into Aug 3 and patience costs almost nothing, so watchlist is the honest posture.
